we have generated a knockin mouse that carries the R334H mutation of the mouse p53 gene, the mouse homolog of the human TP53 R337H mutation, which is a founder mutation that is prevalent in the southern and southeastern regions of Brazil and is considered a founder mutation that causes Li-Fraumanen Syndrome (LFS).
